entries.title: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
entries.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

entries.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
entries.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

entries.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit amid underlying tensions
entries.summary: On Thursday, the two leaders will hold meetings where Trump and Xi are expected to talk about artificial intelligence, rare earths, trade and geopolitics such as Iran and Taiwan.

entries.title: Judge restores journalists' White House access. And, Tucker Carlson on his MAGA split
entries.summary: A judge has ordered that the Trump administration restore journalists' access to White House. And, Tucker Carlson sits down with Morning Edition's Steve Inskeep for a Newsmakers interview.

entries.title: Needy couples got cash and a spending plan. Results were good -- and bad
entries.summary: In Liberia, joint financial planning boosted cash aid's benefits. It also had an unexpected consequence for some families.

entries.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
entries.summary: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.

entries.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
entries.summary: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

entries.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
entries.summary: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

entries.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump
entries.summary: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.

entries.title: States threaten action against company profiting off disabled vets after NPR report
entries.summary: The investigations by attorneys general follow a recent bankruptcy filing in the face of civil lawsuits, falling revenues, and impending debt payments.
